```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(VGAM)
```

## Load Data

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
load("brfss2013.RData")
```

## Prepare data

```{r}
df <- brfss2013 %>%
  mutate(
    genhlth = ifelse(genhlth %in% c(7, 9), NA, genhlth),
    sex = ifelse(sex %in% c(7, 9), NA, sex),
    X_age80 = ifelse(X_age80 %in% c(777, 999), NA, X_age80),
    X_bmi5 = ifelse(X_bmi5 %in% c(9999), NA, X_bmi5),
    X_smoker3 = ifelse(X_smoker3 %in% c(7, 9), NA, X_smoker3)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Health = ordered(
      genhlth,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
    ),
    Age = as.numeric(X_age80),
    Gender = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    BMI = as.numeric(X_bmi5) / 100,
    Smoking = factor(
      X_smoker3,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("Every day", "Some days", "Former smoker", "Never smoked")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Health, Age, Gender, BMI, Smoking) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  droplevels()
```



```{r}
table(df$Health)
table(df$Gender)
table(df$Smoking)
summary(df$Age)
summary(df$BMI)
```




## Parallel Model

```{r}
parallel_model <- MASS::polr(
  Health ~ Age + Gender + BMI + Smoking,
  data = df,
  Hess = TRUE
)

summary(parallel_model)
```


## Create prediction data

```{r}
newdata <- data.frame(
  Age = seq(min(df$Age), max(df$Age), length.out = 100),
  Gender = factor(rep("Male", 100), levels = levels(df$Gender)),
  BMI = rep(mean(df$BMI), 100),
  Smoking = factor(rep("Never smoked", 100), levels = levels(df$Smoking))
)
```



## Predicted probabilities for parallel model

```{r}
pred_parallel <- predict(parallel_model, newdata = newdata, type = "probs")

plot_parallel <- cbind(newdata, as.data.frame(pred_parallel)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"),
    names_to = "Health",
    values_to = "Probability"
  )
```

## Plot for parallel model

```{r}
ggplot(plot_parallel, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, color = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Parallel Model: Predicted Probabilities by Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 
```

## Non-Parallel Model

```{r}
nonparallel_model <- VGAM::vglm(
  Health ~ Age + Gender + BMI + Smoking,
  family = VGAM::cumulative(link = "logitlink", parallel = FALSE),
  data = df
)

summary(nonparallel_model)
```



## Predicted probabilities for non-parallel model
```{r}
pred_nonparallel <- predict(nonparallel_model, newdata = newdata, type = "response")

plot_nonparallel <- cbind(newdata, as.data.frame(pred_nonparallel)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"),
    names_to = "Health",
    values_to = "Probability"
  )
```


## Plot for non-parallel model

```{r}
ggplot(plot_nonparallel, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, color = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Non-Parallel Model: Predicted Probabilities by Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## combine both into one comparison plot

```{r}
plot_parallel$Model <- "Parallel"
plot_nonparallel$Model <- "Non-parallel"

plot_both <- bind_rows(plot_parallel, plot_nonparallel)

ggplot(plot_both, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, color = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Model) +
  labs(
    title = "Parallel vs Non-Parallel Model",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Compare models

```{r}
AIC(parallel_model)
AIC(nonparallel_model)

BIC(parallel_model)
BIC(nonparallel_model)
```
